name: Last Signal: NorthLine
summary:
They cut the signal. You have to bring it back.

Step into Northline as Sam, fighting to open an evacuation route after a deliberate lockdown. Follow radio guidance from Mara and Lena, uncover what happened and keep the civilian convoy's emergency channel alive.

FOUR CONNECTED CHAPTERS
DEAD AIR: Recover an orange power cell, restore the relay and defend the transmission.
PAPER TRAIL: Retrieve three archive records and protect the evidence uplink.
